description: Charter fixture corpus for MDL-guided synthesis selection. Four shapes: positive (MDL winner matches operator label — captures domain terms better than vague alternatives), redundancy (MDL prefers precise domain-term summaries over padded vague ones), compression-resistant (MDL must not override agreement), prompt-bump drift (MDL disagreement spike detection). Note: two-part MDL (concatenation-based joint compression) rewards candidates that share vocabulary with the evidence bundle, so all positive/redundancy fixtures compare non-copy summaries that differ in domain-term precision.

fixtures.note: MDL prefers the candidate that captures domain terminology from the evidence over a vague paraphrase of similar length. Both are summaries, not copies.
fixtures.evidence_bundle: Authentication uses Bearer JWT tokens signed with RS256. Tokens expire after 24 hours. Refresh via POST /auth/refresh with a valid unexpired token.

candidates.text: The service uses tokens for authentication. They expire after some time.

fixtures.metric: Domain-precise summary must have lower MDL total than vague paraphrase

fixtures.note: MDL prefers the candidate with precise domain tokens over a longer padded one without domain vocabulary.
fixtures.evidence_bundle: The build system uses Make. Object files land in build/obj/. The entry point is src/main.c. Tests run via make test.

candidates.text: Recursive Make: build/obj/, src/main.c entry, make test.
The project uses a build system. There are some source files and test commands.

fixtures.metric: Informative domain-term summary must beat padded vague summary

fixtures.note: MDL penalises hollow candidates that avoid domain vocabulary. Informatively hollow candidates have higher residual because the evidence is less predictable from them, raising the MDL total.
fixtures.evidence_bundle: Rate limiting is enforced per API key. Default limit: 100 req/min. Excess requests receive HTTP 429.

candidates.text: Rate limit: 100 req/min per API key; 429 on excess.
There are some limits on API requests which may result in errors.

fixtures.metric: Domain-precise candidate must beat hollow vague candidate

fixtures.note: Short but factually wrong candidate must NOT win over longer correct one if agreement gate is respected. MDL is a tie-break only — this fixture validates the gate is not bypassed.
fixtures.evidence_bundle: The primary database is PostgreSQL 15 running on port 5432.
fixtures.note: c2 is in a different (minority) agreement cluster; MDL must not rescue it.
Same evidence, pre-bump candidates (no hedging) vs post-bump candidates (hedged). MDL disagreement fraction should exceed the 0.30 threshold, triggering a review flag.
fixtures.evidence_bundle: Configuration defaults are loaded from YAML. Overrides can be applied via environment variables or a runtime config patch.

pre_bump_candidates.text: Config: YAML defaults, env-var overrides, runtime patch.

post_bump_candidates.text: It appears that configuration defaults may potentially be loaded from YAML files, with possible overrides potentially applicable via environment variables or a runtime config patch, if supported.

fixtures.note: Stable prompt: MDL winners agree pre/post-bump; no alert should fire.
